label: b1-fixtures-R7
text:
Node fixtures-R7 (3 of 10): write test cases for R7: at least two that break the rule, as files in /opt/enforce/fixtures/R7/flag, and at least two that follow it, in /opt/enforce/fixtures/R7/pass. Each is one file of what the check reads (A function or a method. Where: in the source files; read them with a parser (/opt/enforce-toolbox/skeletons/names_python.py, /opt/enforce-toolbox/skeletons/names_js.py), or with Semgrep patterns Which files: every file that holds code, decided when the check runs (/opt/enforce-toolbox/targets/source-code/source-file.md); take embedded code out of its container first (a `<script>` in HTML), then parse it); make them like what the agent may really write.
Done when: /opt/enforce/fixtures/R7/flag and /opt/enforce/fixtures/R7/pass each hold at least two files. The harness checks this when you reply.
